name: app-shell-publishing-console
title: Inset icon rail · per-section navigation, site, publication and environment switchers
description: Inset icon rail · per-section navigation, site, publication and environment switchers. Blocks/App Shell pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/AppShell and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.
